description: The same disagreement as kernel-samedir-order, moved across a directory boundary, where it stops being determinable: procps walks /run/sysctl.d and /usr/lib/sysctl.d in its own documented order and systemd-sysctl merges them by filename, so which of 0x01b6 and 176 is in force after a reboot depends on which tool applied them. UNKNOWN. The pair of fixtures is the whole distinction: same disagreement, same values, and only the directory differs.
